handoffs.message: Implementation complete. Please review PR #769 (task/ASST-BFF-001 → dev). Changes: (1) openclaw_ops_client.py: added invoke_assistant() and get_assistant_readiness() methods; (2) main.py: feature flag PANTHEON_ASSISTANT_ENABLED gates the assistant ask flow, new SSE events ask.message.delta + ask.message.completed, module-level transcript store wiring, deterministic degraded fallback; (3) tests/test_assistant_agora_ask.py: 7 tests cover enabled/disabled/degraded/replay/transcript readback. All 7 new tests pass, 54 existing assistant/nl-ask tests pass. Commit fd4813a6.

Review blocker on PR #769: /bff/agora/ask invokes provider without assistant context_pack and appends transcript turns without creating/updating the assistant session lifecycle, so route-level transcript readback/source refs are not wired. GitHub review comment 4405734294 recorded. Local validation still passes: ASST-BFF-001 7 tests and assistant/nl-ask 54 tests.

Review blocker addressed. Changes in commit d55345ff: (1) _assistant_build_context_pack called before invoke_assistant, context_pack dict passed to provider; (2) AssistantSession created in _ASSISTANT_SESSION_STORE keyed by agora session_id on first ask; (3) context_pack_id propagated to user and assistant transcript turns; (4) session update_context called after invocation. New test AC#6b verifies session lifecycle and context_pack wiring. All 8 ASST-BFF-001 tests pass; 54 regression tests pass. Ready for re-review.

Codex2 re-review approved d55345ff. Local ASST-BFF tests 8/8 and assistant/context/session/NL regression 66/66 passed; PR #769 branch checks green. PR remains BEHIND, so owner must refresh base during closeout before merge/done.
